crafts.name: Night Light
instructions: Take a drawing or design and place it against the can
Poke holes in the can tracing the outline
You now have a design on the can
Carefully place the string lights through the sipping hole, leaving the switch out
Turn off the lights and see your design come to life!
crafts.sustainability_note: The soda can doubles as a cute night light with a chic design, preventing waste and extending the life of the material.
environmental_benefits: The can is durable and lightweight, making it perfect for a portable night light

crafts.name: DIY Pin
instructions: Cut the bottom of a soda can and remove all sharp aluminum bits, leaving the hard bottom to be used as a pin
Sand down the bottom
Paint desired colours or attach a printout design onto it
Hot glue the ends of a safety pin to the plain side
Apply a coat of clear nail polish to prevent the design from fading
You now have a pin!
crafts.sustainability_note: Reusing soda cans for fashion accessories promotes recycling in the fashion industry. The sturdy base and durable material make the pin long-lasting.
environmental_benefits: Prevents waste from entering landfills and harming the environment

crafts.name: Soda Can Wall Decor
instructions: Decide on a shape such as a heart or star, preferably one with parallel sides
Choose the number of cans needed depending on the desired size: 4-5 for small, 8-10 for medium, and 15-19 for large designs
Hot glue the cans together to form the shape
Paint the wall decor if desired
Hang it on the wall using double-sided tape
You now have a stylish room decoration!
crafts.sustainability_note: Multiple soda cans can be reused at once. Their lightweight material makes the decoration easy to move and reposition.
environmental_benefits: Prevents accumulation in landfills and reduces environmental damage

crafts.name: Soda Tab Bracelet
instructions: Paint the soda can tabs if desired
Use pliers or strong scissors to cut a line through the thin side of the tab
Insert another soda tab through the line, then cut a line through that one
Repeat until you create a bracelet that fits you
Your bracelet is complete!
crafts.sustainability_note: Soda tabs are transformed into an eye-catching accessory instead of being thrown away.
